-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem backend.fkCl_parts (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (D : backend.Data) :
    backend.fkCl γ P D ⊢ backend.fkOwn γ (backend.fkInit D) ∗ backend.fkV γ (backend.fkWInit P D)

theorem backend.newPostK_named (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (W Pk K : backend.BNames →
    IProp GF) (b : Loc) (D : backend.Data) : backend.newPostK γ P W Pk K b D ⊢ "#HnB" ∷
    backend.isBackend γ P (W γ) (Pk γ) b ∗ "#HnSC" ∷ backend.isStopChans γ b ∗ "HnK" ∷ K γ ∗ "HnV" ∷
    backend.bViewC γ 1 (backend.vData P (D, { bks := ∅, ver := W64 0 })) true ∗ "HnH" ∷
    backend.plHook γ func.nil ∗ "HnRB" ∷ backend.rbOwn γ (backend.rbData P D) ∗ ("HnRT" ∷ [∗list] _x
    ∈ List.replicate sync.rwmutex.actualMaxReaders.toNat (), backend.rdTok γ P b) ∗ "HnDl" ∷
    backend.dlInit γ ∗ "HnFk" ∷ backend.fkCl γ P D ∗ "HnSr" ∷ backend.srSlot b

theorem backend.thinV_intro (γ : backend.BNames) (vd L : backend.VData) : (⌜∀ (nk : GoString ×
    GoString) (v : GoString), vd !! nk = some v → L !! nk = some v⌝ ∗ □ ∀ nk, ⌜L !! nk ≠ none ∧ vd
    !! nk = none⌝ -∗ backend.dlIs γ nk) ⊢ backend.thinV γ vd L

theorem backend.kvsOutRd_nil (E : CoPset) (rtx : Loc) (keys vals : GoSlice) : backend.kvsOutRd rtx
    keys vals [] ⊢ |={E}=> ownSlice keys [] DFrac.discard ∗ ownSlice vals [] DFrac.discard

theorem backend.dlIs_of_dlReg (γ : backend.BNames) (Φ : GoString × GoString → IProp GF) (nk :
    GoString × GoString) : backend.dlReg γ Φ ∗ □ Φ nk ⊢ backend.dlIs γ nk

theorem backend.fkPut_of_fk (γ : backend.BNames) (n k : GoString) (h : backend.fkKey n k) :
    backend.fkPut γ n k = iprop(∃ f, backend.fkOwn γ f)

theorem backend.rdB_iff (rtx : Loc) (s : GoSlice) (b : GoString) : backend.rdB rtx s b ⊣⊢ ownSlice s
    b DFrac.discard ∨ backend.txBytes rtx s b

theorem backend.fkCl_open (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (D : backend.Data) :
    backend.fkCl γ P D ⊢ backend.fkOwn γ (backend.fkInit D) ∗ backend.fkV γ (backend.fkWInit P D) ∗
    backend.fkOpen γ (backend.fkInit D) (backend.fkVals D)

theorem backend.kvsOutRd_single (E : CoPset) (rtx : Loc) (keys vals : GoSlice) (k v : GoString) :
    backend.kvsOutRd rtx keys vals [(k, v)] ⊢ |={E}=> ∃ ksl vsl, ownSlice keys [ksl] DFrac.discard ∗
    backend.rdB rtx ksl k ∗ ownSlice vals [vsl] DFrac.discard ∗ backend.rdB rtx vsl v

theorem backend.guarded_RLock (hRL : backend.readTx.RLock.spec) (γ : backend.BNames) (G : Qp → IProp
    GF) (f : Qp → Qp) (hG1 : ∀ (q : Qp), G q ⊢ |={⊤}=> backend.bOpen γ (f q) ∗ (backend.bOpen γ (f
    q) ={⊤}=∗ G q)) (P : backend.BParams) (W Pk : IProp GF) (b rt : Loc) (q : Qp) : ⊢ ∀ Φ, isPkgInit
    pkg_id.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend ∗ backend.isBackend γ P W Pk b ∗ typedPointsto
    (backend.bF go!"readTx" b) rt DFrac.discard ∗ backend.rdTok γ P b ∗ G q -∗ ▷ ((∃ rtx rv,
    backend.rtHeld γ P b rtx rv ∗ G q) -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗ WP ((intoVal (methods
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.readTx.ty.PointerType go!"RLock" (intoVal rt)))
    (intoVal ())) {{ Φ }}

theorem backend.sData_lookup (P : backend.BParams) (S : backend.Data) (nk : GoString × GoString) :
    backend.sData P S !! nk = if P.HB nk.fst = true then none else backend.dget S nk.fst nk.snd

theorem backend.dlReg_dlIs (γ : backend.BNames) (Φ : GoString × GoString → IProp GF) (nk : GoString
    × GoString) : backend.dlReg γ Φ ∗ backend.dlIs γ nk ⊢ ▷ Φ nk

theorem backend.newPost_named (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (W Pk : backend.BNames →
    IProp GF) (b : Loc) (D : backend.Data) : backend.newPost γ P W Pk b D ⊢ "#HnB" ∷
    backend.isBackend γ P (W γ) (Pk γ) b ∗ "#HnSC" ∷ backend.isStopChans γ b ∗ "HnOpen" ∷
    backend.bOpen γ 1 ∗ "HnV" ∷ backend.bViewC γ 1 (backend.vData P (D, { bks := ∅, ver := W64 0 }))
    true ∗ "HnH" ∷ backend.plHook γ func.nil ∗ "HnWb" ∷ ownToks γ.wb backend.wbInit ∗ "HnRB" ∷
    backend.rbOwn γ (backend.rbData P D) ∗ ("HnRT" ∷ [∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate
    sync.rwmutex.actualMaxReaders.toNat (), backend.rdTok γ P b) ∗ "HnDl" ∷ backend.dlInit γ ∗
    "HnFk" ∷ backend.fkCl γ P D ∗ "HnSr" ∷ backend.srSlot b

theorem backend.hkPut_of_not_HK (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (n k : GoString) (S :
    backend.Data) (h : P.HK n k = false) : ⊢ backend.hkPut γ P n k S

theorem backend.fkOpen_fkV (γ : backend.BNames) (n : Nat) (v : backend.FkVals) : backend.fkOpen γ n
    v ∗ backend.fkV γ true ⊢ backend.fkVR γ (true, n, v)

theorem backend.fkWInit_of_wf {P : backend.BParams} {D : backend.Data} (h : backend.fkWfD P D) :
    backend.fkWInit P D = true

theorem backend.fkKey_iff (n k : GoString) : backend.fkKey n k ↔ n = go!"meta" ∧ (k =
    go!"scheduledCompactRev" ∨ k = go!"finishedCompactRev")
